w5h.ev.confederal_congress.title: Regional Confederal Charter Congress
w5h.ev.confederal_congress.desc: Envoys from neighboring capitals have invited our parliament to draft a joint confederal charter harmonizing customs, rail networks and mutual security guarantees.
w5h.ev.confederal_congress.con1: Regional market access expands and diplomatic goodwill deepens across the neighborhood.
w5h.ev.confederal_congress.con2: Domestic authority consolidates while cross-border integration slows.
w5h.ev.language_charter.title: Regional Language and Cultural Charter
w5h.ev.language_charter.desc: Civic assemblies from historic provinces have petitioned for official bilingual schools, municipal charters and cultural broadcasting funding.
w5h.ev.language_charter.con1: Provincial grievances recede and national cohesion strengthens at a modest budget cost.
w5h.ev.language_charter.con2: Central bureaucracy stays streamlined, though regionalist movements gain fresh recruits.
w5h.ev.customs_union.title: Cross-Border Customs Corridor Proposal
w5h.ev.customs_union.desc: Border chambers of commerce and freight operators are lobbying to dismantle customs checkpoints and harmonize industrial tariffs with adjacent states.
w5h.ev.customs_union.con1: Trade reach and industrial productivity rise as cross-border bottlenecks clear.
w5h.ev.customs_union.con2: Tariff receipts bolster the treasury while regional trade access narrows.
w5h.ev.devolution_vote.title: Provincial Devolution Petition
w5h.ev.devolution_vote.desc: A coalition of mayors and civic movements has gathered enough signatures to force a national parliamentary debate on regional tax retention and self-rule.
w5h.ev.devolution_vote.con1: Civic movements choose the ballot box over confrontation, lifting national stability.
w5h.ev.devolution_vote.con2: Central prerogatives hold, but regionalist agitation intensifies.
w5h.ev.currency_corridor.title: Regional Clearing and Settlement Pact
w5h.ev.currency_corridor.desc: Central banks across the region have proposed a joint sovereign clearing corridor to settle cross-border trade and cushion exchange-rate volatility.
w5h.ev.currency_corridor.con1: Credit confidence improves and imported inflation cools.
w5h.ev.currency_corridor.con2: The central bank keeps full discretion and short-term fiscal flexibility.
w5h.ev.rail_gauge.title: Trans-Border Rail Standardization
w5h.ev.rail_gauge.desc: Transport ministries have tabled a joint engineering plan to standardize track gauges, signaling and container terminals across regional frontiers.
w5h.ev.rail_gauge.con1: Construction capacity and regional market access climb sharply after capital outlays.
w5h.ev.rail_gauge.con2: Costs stay contained while delivering a modest productivity boost.
w5h.ev.diaspora_summit.title: Global Diaspora Investment Congress
w5h.ev.diaspora_summit.desc: Business leaders and scholars from overseas diaspora communities have convened to fund regional universities, fintech hubs and municipal bonds.
w5h.ev.diaspora_summit.con1: Inflows strengthen the treasury and raise household living standards.
w5h.ev.diaspora_summit.con2: Institutional autonomy is reinforced without relying on external remittances.
w5h.ev.heraldic_convention.title: National Symbols and Heritage Convention
w5h.ev.heraldic_convention.desc: Historians, regional governors and civic delegates have proposed a joint heritage festival celebrating shared emblems, regional banners and constitutional history.
w5h.ev.heraldic_convention.opt1: Sponsor an Inclusive Civic Heritage Charter
w5h.ev.heraldic_convention.con1: Public trust and institutional stability rise across diverse regions.
w5h.ev.heraldic_convention.con2: Patriotic resolve hardens in support of national defence.
w5h.ev.archipelago_compact.title: Blue-Water Shipping and Coast Guard Compact
w5h.ev.archipelago_compact.desc: Neighboring maritime ministries have proposed joint hydrographic charting, search-and-rescue hubs and shared port security across adjacent sea lanes.
w5h.ev.archipelago_compact.con1: Naval crews sharpen readiness and regional trade flows accelerate.
w5h.ev.archipelago_compact.con2: Port fees lift immediate revenues while straining maritime neighbors.
